import ast
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\optimizer.py')
module = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cls = next(n for n in module.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'Optimizer')
status = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'status')
assert status.args.kwonlyargs[0].arg == 'include_sealed_runs'
assert ast.literal_eval(status.args.kw_defaults[0]) is False
conditional = next(n for n in ast.walk(status) if isinstance(n, ast.IfExp) and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name) and n.test.id == 'include_sealed_runs')
expr = compile(ast.Expression(conditional), str(path), 'eval')
for runs, expected in [([], 0), ([{'state': 'open'}], 0), ([{'state': 'sealed'}, {'state': 'open'}, {'state': 'sealed'}], 2)]:
    assert eval(expr, {'runs': runs, 'include_sealed_runs': False}) == {}
    result = eval(expr, {'runs': runs, 'include_sealed_runs': True})
    assert result == {'sealed_runs': expected}
    assert type(result['sealed_runs']) is int
print('Optional sealed-run count checks passed')
